text: O sar'inanii on e diina kan, sugu ko O yamirnoo kon Nuuhu yottingol gollitiri, e kon ko Men wahayini e maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo. O sar'inani on kadi, sugu ko Men yamirnoo kon Ibraahiima, e Muusaa e Iisaa'en fow yo yottin gollitira, wonnde: ñiiɓinee diina kan; hara on seertaali e makka. Kono ko noddataa sirkooɓe ɓen e mun kon, yo ɓe bajjinɗin Allah, woɗɗitoo e sirku, ɗum mawnii e dow maɓɓe. Allah non, Himo suɓoo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, O hawrindida ɗum ko rewa Mo ɗoftoo Mo, O fewna kala tuuboowo yiltoo e junuubi mun.
